prompt.en: Which part of Canada did the painter Emily Carr take as her subject?
prompt.fr: Quelle région du Canada la peintre Emily Carr a-t-elle prise comme sujet?

options.en: The forests of the West Coast.
options.fr: Les forêts de la côte Ouest.

options.en: The wheat fields of the Prairies.
options.fr: Les champs de blé des Prairies.
Les villages de pêche de Terre-Neuve.

explanation.en: Emily Carr is known for her paintings of the West Coast forests.
explanation.fr: Emily Carr est connue pour ses tableaux des forêts de la côte Ouest.

source.quote: Emily Carr painted the forests and Aboriginal artifacts of the West Coast.
